title: Construct a phase-compatible exactness domain for the literal P104 collector
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR[3068](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3068)'s period-domain handoff leaves phase-compatible state exactness open. This contribution constructs an explicit Gaussian Newton domain for the complete literal P104 collector, with a self-contained all-rank proof and a separate implementation.

For `pi=1+i`, let `B_r` contain the arrays whose multilinear coefficient `a_S` is divisible by `pi^|S|`. The encoder is `E_r = [[1,0],[1,pi]]^tensor-r`; the butterfly becomes the integral coefficient update `(c0,c1) -> (c0+c1,i*c1)`.

- Boolean Möbius inversion proves that B_r is exactly the integral entrance on which **every partial coordinate product C_T** remains integral.
- Explicit integral intertwiners prove closure under the actual affine-address/quadratic-Gaussian-phase wrapper alphabet. The credited signed-floor pair is ideal at every admitted prefix.
- The original PR[2586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2586) events **2025–2039**, including both separately archived U and V recipes and all four wrappers, implement `(D,Q,C=0) -> (D,Q+U sum(D),C=0)` exactly for five borrowed sources and an arbitrarily dirty query in `2^-f B_9`.

This is a different phase-compatible domain, with no global containment claim about the earlier Gamma/Lambda lattices. Classical Clifford/Barnes–Wall constructions retain their authorship. The added value is the quantified domain, its actual complete collector binding and its explicit codec/consumer boundary.

## Local bill and remaining obligations

The actual wrappers have cycles `[64,128,160,64]`: **416 cycles and 2,464 swaps**. A rejecting control prevents substitution of PR[3025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3025)'s different paired-inverse invoice, 384 cycles/2,432 swaps. The direct collector retains eleven array ADDs, 3,584 pair applications, 39,936 real additions/subtractions, 14,336 floor halves, component traversal and explicit private workspace.

An optional source-preserving cold coefficient caller pays for five owned copies, six encodes, six decodes and ten copy/cleanup ADDs. It adds **120,832 real additions/subtractions, 27,648 exact halvings and 2,560 owned complex words**. Its logical target is **E^-1 U E**. The proof and receipt include sufficient direct and composed finite headroom.

Earlier-producer admission, later quarter-source membership in `4 B_r`, an actual compatible consumer, physical owners/routing/control/precision, native recursive tariffs and a favorable complete supplier bill remain open. The package claims no new precision threshold, physical saving, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change. Human/proof-kernel review, native compiler and whole-word/selected-baseline replays are unrun.

## Validation

- Primary: 2,450 signed pair cases; 1,234 generator intertwiners; four dense signed collectors with every prefix checked; the full cold codec schedule; source/frame/ownership/cleanup/domain/invoice controls.
- Separate reconstruction: all **512 ideal complex columns**, all **1,024 signed module columns**, **3,670,016 pair-level exact comparisons**, all wrapper addresses/phases and three additional dense collectors. It was implemented before reading the primary model/proof and imports no predecessor executable. This is separate automated checking, not independent human review.
- Registered **CPython 3.12.14 normal and optimized** replays and metadata/source-pin validation PASS. A **23-file source-complete Git-free export** passes the optimized full replay with all bytes unchanged; missing/corrupted scientific inputs fail before execution.
- Complete receipt SHA256: `7aa3d2274fdc0cd3f93da9c89f0b783991af657de8fa683627f0d7bbc8365a52`. The public commit's tree is byte-identical to the reviewed local tree.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-clifford-exactness
```

The [package README](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2834523b1cd4ea83ba7a043e2e2f5f3332cf9909/research/p104-clifford-exactness), proof, complete receipt and independent review provide the exact contracts. Hosted CI is separate from the local PASS evidence.

## Task and overlap

Ten additive package files, based on canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Task `p104-side-correction`, **changed scope**, original scope key `c5367b1a1b7bed20db53`. The original card, seed, family gate and checkpoints are retained in TASK.json.

[Advance claim in Discussion2750](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19008062). Canonical main and guidance were unchanged at the 23:43 UTC checkpoint. The fresh check covered all 287 open PR records and 181 visible Discussion records across five threads; Discussion pagination and sparse local coverage remain incomplete. New P104 relay/channel coefficient work in [PR #3363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3363)/[PR #3365](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3365)/[PR #3371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3371)/[PR #3372](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3372) has a different obligation. No exhaustive novelty claim is made.

## Credit and open next questions

Credit ywz65/PR[2586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2586) (`7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1`), Tekalign/PR[3025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3025) (`a544ef068a46f4de3bc47d1d02149cbdc3ba547f`), Ross Richardson/PR[3068](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3068) (`7d2c519a1fdcc6bf66f6f08757eed7c48762d3f2`), Arham Tahir's retained collector/numerical work, Nick Petalas's period/precision work, Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales's Gaussian parity work and the retained native/geometry/compiler lineage. Jose Manuel's PR[3087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3087) physical monomial work remains related context with its own assumptions. Nebe, Rains and Sloane retain the classical Clifford/Barnes–Wall literature credit. Exact consumed source pins, original headers and notices are retained.

The smallest useful next step is to bind one actual producer or downstream consumer, prove its Newton divisibility/intertwiner and charge the whole boundary. The [Open next questions](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2834523b1cd4ea83ba7a043e2e2f5f3332cf9909/research/p104-clifford-exactness#open-next-questions) record the blockers and stopping decision. This result is retained as one local contract; further implementation expansion requires that evidence.

Prepared by **Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI assistance**, including three concurrent agents for algebra, independent reconstruction and source/cost review. Apache-2.0.
